list: The official 55 trophies, as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words; every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, from the official description.
note: GTA VI launched 19 November 2026. Where a guide says 'not yet verified in play', the advice is drawn from the official trophy description alone and no location or step is claimed as checked in the game. Story trophies are replayable from the mission replay menu, so a missed story beat can be recovered.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (official names, descriptions and grades): https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PSN progress counts): https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.guide: There is nothing extra to do for this one: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. Treat it as the finish line, not a task — follow the roadmap in order (story, then character strands, then collectibles and activities, then cleanup) and this arrives last by itself. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the roadmap is our own, built from the official descriptions.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the game, so this is unmissable in practice as long as you play the story. It is flagged here because it belongs to a one-time story beat: if you ever need it again, replay the mission from the mission replay menu. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies come from story progress alone — no side objective is needed — so just keep following the story missions until the chapter closes. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Like every chapter trophy, it is awarded for story progress alone, so there is nothing to hunt for — finish the chapter's missions in order. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. Chapter trophies need no side objective, so keep to the story missions until the chapter closes. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end — the last chapter trophy before the finale. Finish the chapter's missions in order; no extra objective is attached. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission. It is the story's endpoint, so it comes naturally at the end of Chapter 4 and the finale — the gold grade marks it as a milestone, not a hard task. If you finish the story and it has not popped, replay the final mission from the replay menu. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies are awarded on completion alone, so play the mission through; the name suggests an early, low-stakes job, so do not expect a hard fight. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in GTA games are set pieces with a planned approach — follow the mission's own objectives and the trophy pops on completion. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies it is awarded for finishing the mission, so there is no extra condition to meet. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The title points at a high-profile job; play the mission through its objectives and the trophy pops on completion. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown — a job at Vice City International Airport, judging by the name. Finish the mission's objectives; the trophy is for completion, not for a particular method. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The name suggests a large-scale operation; follow the mission objectives through and the trophy pops when it ends. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion counter. In GTA games that counter covers the story, the side strands, the collectibles and the activities — in practice, earning every other trophy gets you most of the way there, so treat this as a cleanup check: when only this and the platinum are left, open the stats screen, find what the counter still lists, and finish those items. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the completion breakdown is our own reading of the official description, not yet verified in play.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, airtime and other driving feats the game counts as a stunt. This is a grind best done passively: drive aggressively between objectives and the count climbs on its own. To finish it deliberately, find a long straight with ramps or jumps, use a fast car or bike, and repeat big jumps; the counter is tracked on PSN, so check your progress there. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 250).
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — you only need to sample them, not win or master any. The activities are the ones the other trophies name (races, drone races, fishing, arcade games, shooting range, bowling, hunting, meditation and challenges), so play one round of each and this pops. If one type is not popping, check which activity the game lists that you have not touched yet. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the 9-type count is from PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is one of the hardest silvers: gold means tight accuracy and speed, so learn each challenge's target pattern, use the weapon the range gives you, and replay a challenge until the gold threshold clears — bronze or silver on a challenge does not count. Work through the list methodically and note which ones are still below gold. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 42).
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is a separate race, so you need a win at every one — losing a race does not count, but you can retry it as often as you like. Learn each course's gates before pushing for speed, and tick locations off one at a time. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 14).
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the word 'different' matters, so repeating the same race does not help. Work through the race list across Leonida, one win per event, and keep a note of which events you have already won. Any vehicle race counts; pick the events you are fastest at first. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 20).
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head contests against a named rival, so the win comes from catching more or better fish than Cal within the challenge's rules — focus on the challenge's own scoring (size, count or species, whichever it states) rather than fishing freely. You can retry a lost challenge. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the retry and scoring notes are our own reading of the official description, not yet verified in play.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game — any cabinet, any game, one full playthrough to its end. Arcade games are quick, so this is one of the easiest bronzes: find a cabinet in an arcade or bar, start a game and see it through to the game-over or completion screen. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Character strands are chains of side missions for one person — keep taking Andy's jobs when they appear until the strand ends with its final mission. The trophy is for the final mission of the chain, so earlier Andy missions are the route to it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Like Andy's strand, this is the end of a chain of side missions for one character — work through Kenton's jobs in order until the final one appears and completes. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Billy's strand is a chain of side missions; complete each job he offers until the chain closes with its final mission. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — the game's Strangers & Freaks-style side content. Strangers appear as markers on the map; each strand is a short chain of missions for one stranger. You need 8 full strands, so explore the state, talk to every stranger you find, and finish each chain before moving on — do not leave a strand half-done and forget it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 8).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Randy's strand is another chain of side missions for one character — take his jobs as they appear and complete the chain to its final mission. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Tyrone's strand is a chain of side missions; work through his jobs in order until the final mission of the chain is done. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places marked on the map or found by exploring — sit, meditate, and move to the next. The count is tracked on PSN, so check how many you still need and sweep the regions you have not visited. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 18).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a specific animal, not just any hunt. The description names one unique animal tied to Bret's strand, so follow Bret's missions until the hunt is offered, then track the animal and take it down as the hunt directs. The exact animal and ground are not pinned down in the official description, so treat any specific location you read elsewhere as unverified until you see it in the game. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — cards are found across Leonida, and a set is complete when you hold every card in it. You only need 3 full sets, not every card in the game, so finish the sets whose cards you find first and stop hunting once the third set closes. Track which cards you hold per set so you know which ones are still missing. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 3).
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 locations — the game's photo or check-in style collectible, done at marked spots across the state. This is a long sweep: 100 spots means visiting most of Leonida, so combine it with exploration and the other collectible hunts rather than doing it alone. The count is tracked on PSN, so check your progress as you go. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 100).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's open-world challenges, separate from story missions. Challenges are the small objectives the game lists in its challenge menu; work through the easiest first (driving, stunts, combat) and the count climbs steadily. Check the challenge list in-game to see which ones you have already finished. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 50).
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Do it somewhere with escape routes — open roads and cover beat a dead end — and use your partner as a second gun while the heat is on. Break line of sight, stay out of the search area until the stars clear, and the trophy pops when you are free. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the method is our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in play.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time — the trick is the 'back-to-back' and the 'without losing' parts. Plan a route of three nearby shops, hit them quickly one after another, and do not let the wanted level drop between robberies. Keep moving and keep your partner close; if the wanted level clears, the chain breaks and you start over. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the method is our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in play.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in or drive 100 different vehicle models and the game logs each new one. This climbs passively as you explore: steal or borrow every new car, bike, boat and truck you see rather than sticking to one favourite. The count is tracked on PSN, so check your progress and hunt the rarer types (aircraft, boats) last. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 100).
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus — the game's slow-motion targeting mode. Set it up where enemies cluster: trigger Combat Focus when five or more are in view, and take them down before the meter runs out. A busy shootout or a gang hideout is the place to try it; if you only get three or four, retry the fight. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the method is our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in play.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — leave the airport in a way the schedule never planned, which in GTA terms means stealing a plane and taking off (or otherwise leaving by air without a ticket). Head to VCIA, get to an aircraft, and get airborne; the trophy is for the departure, not for landing anywhere. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the method is our own reading of the official description, not yet verified in play.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — the military tank. The description is a joke, not a target, so the exact trigger is not spelled out in the official list; expect it to involve a Rhino tank, most likely stealing one, surviving one, or taking one down. Try the military base or a high wanted level where Rhinos appear, and engage one directly. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the method is our own reading of the official description, not yet verified in play.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — stealth is the whole condition. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails the condition, so leave and retry rather than fighting through it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the method is our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in play.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — five separate vault jobs, each ending with a clean getaway. Bank vaults are the big robberies, so plan each one: a fast car parked close, a route out, and no lingering at the scene. You do not need to do all five in one session; the count is tracked on PSN, so work through them one at a time. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 5).
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — find one on the road, stop it, take its cargo and get away clean. Any truck counts, so pick a quiet stretch of road where you can work without drawing a big police response. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — every named district and region on the map. The count is tracked on PSN, so open the map, find the areas you have not visited, and drive through each one; simply entering an area should register it. Combine this with the WAiNK sweep and the collectible hunts, since they all send you across the same map. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 52).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — nine separate hits, one per gang. Each gang runs its own operations around Leonida; find one per gang, rob it and escape. Keep a list of which gangs you have hit so you know who is left. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 9).
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — find a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail and enjoy it. This is a quiet moment trophy, not a challenge: go to Ocean Beach, find the drinks spot, and the trophy pops when the scene plays. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom — drive a car straight through the showroom's front in classic GTA style. Find a vehicle showroom, get in a car inside it, and floor it through the glass; the trophy is for the exit, not for the car. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the method is our own reading of the official description, not yet verified in play.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a game of bowling there and follow through (complete the game). The alley is named in the description, so head there, start a game and finish it; a win is not required by the description, just the follow-through. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal — the description is deliberately vague, and the official list gives no count or place, so the trigger is tied to the story's partnership (Lucia and Jason) reaching a public, high-profile beat. Play the story and the partner activities; this is one of the trophies whose exact moment is not pinned down in the official description, so do not chase a specific location for it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count to 500, so this is about the sheer number of decisions you make across the game, in dialogue, missions and the open world. You cannot grind it in one sitting; it accumulates as you play, so it pops naturally during a full playthrough. Keep playing, keep choosing, and check the PSN count if it has not popped late in the game. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 500).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something, then succeed at it on the next attempt. The description is a riddle, not a task list: the natural reading is retrying a failed mission, challenge or activity and passing it the second time. If it has not popped by the end of the story, replay any mission you once failed and pass it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the reading is our own, not yet verified in play.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the game's easter-egg or random-event trophy. The description gives no place or trigger, so this is one to let happen: explore Leonida, follow odd sights and random events, and it will pop when you stumble on the strange thing it names. Do not chase a specific spot from an unverified source. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — hit a pedestrian with a melee weapon while driving past. Equip a melee weapon, drive slowly past a target on foot, and swing as you pass. It takes timing rather than force, so a quiet street with a lone pedestrian is the place to practise; expect a wanted level for it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the method is our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in play.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists and cannot be spent directly — pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the total counts toward the $250,000. Keep robbing and laundering through the story and this pops during normal play; check your laundering total if it has not popped late in the game. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the amount to $250,000).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, food, anything the shops sell. This is cumulative spending, so it climbs through normal play; if it has not popped late in the game, buy the big-ticket items (vehicles, weapons) until the total clears $100,000. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the amount to $100,000).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are properties you purchase for cash and use to store vehicles — find each one on the map, pay its price, and the trophy pops when the eighth is yours. This costs real in-game money, so save for it or finish it after the big story payouts. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 8).
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game delivery or vehicle app. Drive or own a vehicle, open the Scooter Bros app, and register it; repeat with 10 different vehicles. The count is tracked on PSN, so check your progress and register any vehicle you have not used yet. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN tracks the count to 10).
trophies.name: On the Spot
